snippet.title: Alchemist Historical Simulator teaser
snippet.description:
Greetings, everyone!

Here's our second concept for a game. Alchemist Historical Simulator invites you into the mystical world of medieval alchemy. Experience the daily lives of true alchemists, experiment with rare ingredients, and craft potions.

Please, share your thoughts in the comments below, we are looking forward to any and all feedback and it is much appreciated.

Also, consider adding Alchemist Historical Simulator to your wishlist on Steam (copy text and remove space): 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265410 /Alchemist_Historical_Simulator/

If you'd like to keep an eye on our projects, be sure to subscribe and check out our social media in the channel's description.

#indiegame #alchemy #historical #unrealengine #casualsim #gamedev
